bulk.title: Bulk transfers
bulk.description: Pay many suppliers from one checked file. Every row is validated, approved as one batch and paid once.
bulk.emptyHint: Download the template, fill it in and upload it here.
bulk.uploadDescription: CSV or XLSX from the bank template, up to the row limit in your agreement. Nothing is paid until a checker approves.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.description: Salary runs paid from the payroll account. Approvers see totals only.
payroll.emptyHint: Payroll officers upload the salary file from the bank template.
payroll.uploadDescription: One pay period per file. Employees come from the employee list; the file carries amounts only.
payroll.aggregateOnly: You can see totals and status. Employee names, accounts and salaries are visible to payroll officers only.

list.caption: Batches
list.noCreate: You can view batches but not upload them.

upload.now: As soon as it is approved
upload.executeAtHint: In your device's time zone, within the next 30 days.
upload.fileHint: CSV or XLSX, up to 5 MB. Formulas and macros are rejected.
upload.correction: This run corrects an earlier one
upload.correctionHint: Every row then needs a correction reference.
upload.noAccounts: You have no account you can pay from for this kind of batch.

detail.identical: This is the same file as {reference}. Rows already confirmed or paid there cannot be paid again.
detail.validating: The file is being validated. This page updates by itself.
detail.processing: Payments are in progress. This page updates by itself.

validationCode.NO_VALID_ROWS: No row passed validation, so nothing can be submitted. Correct the file and upload it again.
validationCode.OTHER: Your agreement does not currently allow this batch. Nothing was submitted.

detail.blockedBody: Nothing has been paid. Fix the cause, then ask for the release again, or cancel the batch.
detail.unknownTitle: Some results are still being checked
detail.unknownBody: The bank is confirming these rows by their original reference. Do not pay them again; they cannot be retried from here.
detail.noAction: There is nothing for you to do on this batch right now.

rows.title: Rows
rows.maskedHelp: Employee detail is hidden from you. You can see how many lines there are and what happened to each.
rows.more: Showing the first {count} rows. Download the file for the full list.

accept.title: Confirm the rows to pay
accept.help: Only valid rows can be paid. You may leave valid rows out; invalid and duplicate rows are never submitted.
accept.confirmInvalid: I confirm that {count} invalid or duplicate rows will not be submitted.
accept.ackWarnings: I have reviewed the rows with warnings and want to pay them.
accept.reviseWarning: Confirming again changes the proposal. Approvals already given become void and the batch must be approved again.

actions.submitHelp: Nothing is debited now. A different person must approve the totals.
actions.acceptRolled: The requested time is not available. Pay at the next available time instead: {when}
actions.retryHelp: Creates a new batch with only the rows that failed before posting. It needs its own confirmation and approval. Settled rows are never paid again.

rowError.UNSAFE_CHARACTERS: The value contains characters that are not allowed
rowError.REFERENCE_FORMAT: The reference format is not valid
rowError.DUPLICATE_REFERENCE: The same row reference appears earlier in the file
rowError.DUPLICATE_BUSINESS_REFERENCE: This row reference was already submitted or paid
rowError.AMOUNT_FORMAT: The amount is not a number
rowError.AMOUNT_DECIMALS: The amount has too many decimal places
rowError.AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE: The amount must be greater than zero
rowError.AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE: The amount is out of range
rowError.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The currency differs from the paying account
rowError.ACCOUNT_SCHEME: The account type is not supported
rowError.ACCOUNT_FORMAT: The account number format is not valid
rowError.NAME_MISMATCH: The name does not match the account holder
rowError.ITEM_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The amount is above the per-item limit
rowError.RAIL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The amount is above the rail limit
rowError.EMPLOYEE_UNKNOWN: The employee code is not in the employee list
rowError.EMPLOYEE_ACCOUNT_UNVERIFIED: The employee's account has not passed the name check
rowError.PAY_PERIOD_FORMAT: The pay period must be written as YYYY-MM
rowError.PAY_PERIOD_MIXED: A file can contain one pay period only
rowError.COMPONENT_INVALID: The component must be SALARY or ALLOWANCE
rowError.COMPONENT_DISABLED: This component is not enabled in your agreement
rowError.NET_NOT_POSITIVE: Net pay must be greater than zero
rowError.DUPLICATE_SALARY: This employee was already paid this component for this period
rowError.CORRECTION_REFERENCE_REQUIRED: A correction needs a correction reference
rowError.CORRECTION_REFERENCE_UNEXPECTED: A correction reference is given but there is no correction

rowWarning.NAME_CLOSE_MATCH: The name is close to, but not exactly, the account holder's name
rowWarning.REPEATED_ACCOUNT: The same account appears more than once in the file
rowWarning.SALARY_CHANGE: Net pay changed by 20% or more since the last payment

approval.changeFlags: Lines with a pay change of 20% or more
approval.aggregateNote: You are approving these totals. Employee names, accounts and individual amounts are not shown to approvers.
approval.bulkNote: You are approving every row of this batch as one decision. Open the batch to inspect the rows.
